name: sourcebraid
description: Capture, search, fetch, and safely manage a private SourceBraid Markdown archive from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Search your private Markdown knowledge archive.
interface.longDescription: Search and fetch prepared Markdown sources from a private GitHub archive in ChatGPT or Codex, maintain an incremental local full-text index, and safely preview and delete clips.
defaultPrompt: Search my SourceBraid archive for dynamic agents.
Find and summarize my saved sources about AI workflows.
Safely preview deletion of a saved SourceBraid source.
